name: A timeout callback is not an error panel
query: Explain this timeout and propose a story-only fixture and assertion. Preserve the component. Do not increase capture delay or loosen visual thresholds.
context: The component schedules a check 10000ms after mount. The check returns if unmounted or current props.connected is true; otherwise it calls onConnectionError(true). A connection message calls onConnectionError(false) and onConnected(). render returns iframe(src). The story pins connected=false, supplies logging callbacks, and uses a nonexistent URL. The parent turns the error callback into a visible error panel. The outer interaction deadline is 15 seconds. Historical Firefox images contain changed glyph-edge pixels, but there is no causal evidence linking those pixels to the timeout.
expected_behavior: Explains the scheduling event, current-prop check, callback, and absence of a component-owned DOM change
Proposes a served script-free HTML fixture that sends no connection message
Passes explicit spies through story args and awaits onConnectionError(true)
Asserts that onConnected and onConnectionError(false) have not occurred before play completes
Keeps the component timer and capture settings unchanged and fits the assertion into the outer budget
Distinguishes a callback-only story from a parent or stateful harness that renders an error panel
success_criteria: Does not claim the timeout changes iframe contents or explains Firefox rasterization
Does not replace the callback assertion with a fixed sleep or synthetic callback call
Reports the proposed fixture and browser behavior as unverified until tests actually run
